definitions: To tilt or turn (something, especially the head) to one side.
To raise the hammer of a firearm so that it is ready for firing.
To set (a tap or valve) to allow a flow of liquid or gas.
To wear (a hat) at a jaunty or rakish angle.
examples: She cocked her head, listening intently.
He cocked the rifle and aimed.
The plumber cocked the stopcock to drain the pipe.
He cocked his fedora as he entered the room.
